interpreter-intrinsic: The interpreter implementation calls a host intrinsic; the compiler supplies its own implementation.
runtime-reflection: The declaration requires runtime program reflection, function lookup or arbitrary expression evaluation excluded from the compiler language model.
sqlite-runtime: The compiler does not yet supply the SQLite runtime binding required by this item.
test-counter: The test requires per-test evaluation counter support that is not yet implemented.
annotation-probe: A controlled failure in a regression fixture used to verify the compiler annotation runner.
compiler-implementation: The compiler supplies a separately maintained implementation with a compatible public contract.
compiler-contract: The existing compiler implementation has a different public contract or the upstream contract cannot yet be established.
container-adaptation: This trait, implementation or member still needs adaptation to the compiler.
missing-implementation: The compiler does not yet provide an implementation for this imported item.
pending-validation: This test is imported but has not yet been classified by execution.
upstream-dependency: The test depends on an imported declaration that is not yet available to the compiler.
compiler-gap: The compiler behavior for this case still differs from the interpreter.
compiler-crash: The compiler or generated program currently terminates abnormally for this case.
interpreter-fixture: This case requires interpreter-specific host fixtures that are not provided by the native test runner.
test-diagnostics: The compiler assertion implementation does not yet render arbitrary values in failure messages.
missing-intrinsic: The test requires an interpreter host intrinsic that the compiler does not yet implement.
compiler-leak: The compiled program currently reports leaked allocations for this case.
compiler-timeout: The case exceeds the compilation or execution time budget used to validate imported tests.
